message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Build Tests

# No need to run on master branch
on:
  push:
    branches: ["*", "!master"]
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, edited, synchronize, reopened]
    branches: ["*", "!master"]

jobs:
  test:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout branch
        uses: actions/checkout@v5

      - name: Setup Nodejs
        uses: actions/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version: "22.19.0"
          cache: npm

      - name: Install Correct NPM Version
        run: npm install -g npm@10.9.3

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Lint
        run: npx --no-install eslint . --quiet",
  "rationale": "The workflow runs `npm install` on every push/PR with no dependency cache, although package-lock.json exists and CI history shows repeated runs. Pattern P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (Cache dependency downloads) reports measured VM-time reduction and requires repeated dependency fetching plus lockfile-based cache inputs, both of which are satisfied here. Adding `cache: npm` to setup-node caches the npm package cache keyed on the lockfile, speeding dependency installation while preserving every install, lint, and test step and all intended coverage. Checkout is moved before setup-node so the lockfile is present for the cache key; no steps are removed, weakened, or replaced, and no new secrets, privileged actions, publishing, deployment, or network access is introduced.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
